name: Vineet Laboratories Limited
summary: Vineet Laboratories Limited researches, develops, makes and sells active pharmaceutical ingredients, intermediates and fine chemicals, mainly in India. Its intermediates relate to drugs such as Lopinavir, Ritonavir, Efavirenz, Nadolol, Glimepiride and Celecoxib, and it also supplies reagents and fine chemicals, n-butyl lithium among them.
